name: Lewis Hamilton
bio: The most decorated driver in F1 history. Seven world titles defined by clinical precision, wet-weather mastery, and an unrivalled competitive hunger.

name: Max Verstappen
bio: Redefining the ceiling of what's possible in a Formula 1 car. Fearless, unyielding, and devastatingly fast in all conditions.

name: Sebastian Vettel
bio: Four consecutive world titles built on dominance, precision, and an encyclopedic technical understanding of every car he ever drove.

name: Charles Leclerc
bio: Ferrari's prince and the fastest qualifier of his generation. A single lap from Leclerc in a red car is one of the most thrilling sights in modern Formula 1.

name: Lando Norris
bio: The cornerstone of McLaren's resurgence. Blazing one-lap pace, fearless wheel-to-wheel racing, and the smile that made a new generation fall for F1.

name: George Russell
bio: Mr. Saturday turned race winner. Ice-cool precision and relentless consistency that earned him the most coveted seat in the sport at Mercedes.

name: Carlos Sainz
bio: The Smooth Operator. A racer's racer who ended Red Bull's record-breaking 2023 win streak — clinical, calculating, and devastating in a straight fight.

name: Sergio Pérez
bio: The king of tyre management and street circuits. Checo's racecraft and ability to make a set of tyres last forever made him the perfect wingman to a champion.

name: Esteban Ocon
bio: Cool, calculated and relentless under pressure. Ocon held off a charging champion for lap after lap in Hungary to seize a maiden win against the odds.

name: Oscar Piastri
bio: Ice-cold from the moment he arrived. A junior-category steamroller whose maturity and racecraft made him a Grand Prix winner faster than almost anyone expected.

name: Kimi Räikkönen
bio: The Iceman — ruthless natural speed wrapped in total indifference to the circus around it. 2007 world champion for Ferrari, and one of the most naturally gifted drivers of his era.

name: Oliver Bearman
bio: Ferrari's academy jewel who scored points on his Formula 1 debut at eighteen — thrown into a sick Carlos Sainz's seat at Jeddah with no practice and racing like he belonged there. Britain's brightest young prospect.

name: Nico Hülkenberg
bio: For years the finest driver never to stand on a Formula 1 podium — a qualifying specialist whose record wait finally ended with a stunning charge through the wet to third at Silverstone in 2025.

name: Andrea Kimi Antonelli
bio: Mercedes' teenage prodigy and the heir to Hamilton's old seat. Fearless raw speed and a maturity beyond his years that had him fighting at the very front almost from the moment he arrived.
